title: Ukuzinikela Ngokuzithandela
intro: Ngesikhathi sovivinyo oluvela kuNkulunkulu, umphefumulo wabizelwa esenzweni sokugcina sokuzithoba. Wakhulela ezweni elingenalutho, lo mfanekiso wakhula waba nokholo nokubekezela. Lapho umbono uyalela umhlatshelo, abazange banqikaze. Indaba yabo iyitshe lesisekelo sokuzinikela.
clues: Ngangiyimpendulo yomthandazo womprofethi omkhulu owayelindelwe isikhathi eside.
Mina nomama sashiywa esigodini esingenalutho sinokudla okunama-date namanzi kuphela.
Ngakhula ngaba umprofethi owaziwa ngokuba neqiniso nokubekezela kwami.
Ngisize ubaba wami ukuphakamisa izisekelo zendlu engcwele enikelwe ku-Allah.
Lapho ubaba engitshela ngephupho lokunginikela, ngaphendula ngathi, 'Yenza njengoba uyaliwe.'
U-Allah wahlonipha ukuzithoba kwami ​​ngokuthumela inqama evela esibhakabhakeni ukuzongihlenga.
arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
